name: Kofin Sync Queue
overview: Typed change queue for the Kofin Kodi client
description: Companion plugin for plugin.video.kofin: records library and user-data changes as typed records (change reason, series/season parents), serves them with query-time Etags and an in-band retention cutoff, so offline Kodi boxes catch up with minimal traffic.

versions.changelog:
- Records carry the libraries they belong to, and the feed can be filtered
  to them, so a client no longer fetches changes from libraries it does not
  sync. Announced as "library-scope" in the Info response's Features list.
- Records left behind by a deleted library are reaped rather than served
  until the retention cutoff.
- Version numbers now track the Jellyfin ABI (10.11.x), so which server a
  build targets is readable from the version alone.
- Releases are built and drafted by CI, and announced to the Kontell
  repository on publish.
- The plugin catalogue shows these notes: meta.json carries the changelog
  the repository manifest has been serving empty until now.

name: SyncPlay v2
overview: SyncPlay protocol v2 served from a plugin
description: SyncPlay protocol v2: versioned state, snapshots, position beacons, adaptive tolerances, bounded group-waits and robust reconnects — serving stock v1 clients and v2 clients from one group registry, replacing the built-in SyncPlay while installed.

versions.changelog:
- Hot join: a v2 member joining a Playing group no longer pauses anyone.
  The group keeps playing, the joiner is pushed a snapshot, loads at the
  live position and rendezvouses via a private scheduled Unpause - with
  the updated kofin client it arrives with initial-start tightness. v1
  joiners (web) keep the classic barrier. Config: HotJoin (default on).
  Conformance: 17/17 fast suite including the new hot_join scenario.
- M1: the full protocol v2 engine (vendored from integration/syncplay-phase1):
  versioned state, snapshots, position beacons, ping-scaled tolerances,
  buffering grace, group-wait deadline, 90s disconnect grace with
  per-version resync. Body-transparent ProtocolVersion negotiation on the
  stock Join/New routes, POST /SyncPlay/Hello capability probe, dedicated
  WebSocket time sync at /SyncPlay/TimeSync, enriched /SyncPlay/List.
  Conformance: 11/12 with the unmodified kit, 12/12 with transport
  discovery; mixed v1+v2 groups verified via the conformance kit (stock-web
  wire compatibility proven in the M0 deployment pass).

- M1: the full protocol v2 engine (vendored from integration/syncplay-phase1):
